# Export scripts of the TextBlockExporter golden tests. The language is the
# one of internal/klimt/svg/svgtest/script.go, plus "export KEY VALUE..."
# settings (see export_test.go); the drawing commands are run by the drawU
# of a text block of size "export dim W H" (100x50 by default).
# internal/klimt/svg/testdata/javagen/SvgGolden.java runs the same scripts
# with upstream's TextBlockExporter and writes golden/<case>.svg and
# golden/imagedata.txt.

case basic
color #181818
bg #FEFECE
rect 80 30 5
translate 10 25
text SansSerif 12 plain - #000000 - - 0 basic
write

case margins
export margin 10 20 30 40
export dim 60.5 20.25
color #181818
rect 60.5 20.25
write

case backcolor
export back #FEFECE
color #181818
rect 10 10
write

case backcolor-transparent
export back transparent
color #181818
rect 10 10
write

case backcolor-gradient
export back #FFFFFF/#AAAAFF
color #181818
rect 10 10
write

case textblock-backcolor
export tbback #FF0000
color #181818
rect 10 10
write

case scale-simple
export scale simple 2
color #181818
bg #FEFECE
rect 20 10 3
translate 5 30
text SansSerif 12 plain - #000000 - - 0 scaled
write

case scale-width
export scale width 300
color #181818
rect 20 10
write

case scale-maxwidth
export scale maxwidth 50
color #181818
rect 20 10
write

case scale-capped
export scale simple 10
color #181818
rect 20 10
write

case dpi
export skinparam dpi 192
color #181818
rect 20 10
write

case border
export skinparam diagramBorderColor #FF0000
export margin 5 5 5 5
color #181818
rect 20 10
write

case border-thickness
export skinparam diagramBorderThickness 3
export skinparam roundCorner 10
color #181818
rect 20 10
write

case skinparam-svg
export skinparam svglinktarget _blank
export skinparam pathHoverColor #00FF00
export skinparam preserveAspectRatio xMinYMin
export skinparam lengthAdjust spacingAndGlyphs
url http://example.com tip
color #181818
path 0 - - M 0 0 L 10 10
endurl
translate 10 20
text SansSerif 12 plain - #000000 - - 0 adjusted
write

case skinparam-nodimension
export skinparam svgDimensionStyle false
color #181818
rect 20 10
write

case fileformatoption
export skinparam svglinktarget _blank
export ffo linktarget _parent
export ffo hover #123456
export ffo preserve xMaxYMax
export ffo decimal 1
url http://example.com
color #181818
rect 20.333 10.666
endurl
write

case diagramtype-sequence
export diagramtype SEQUENCE
export pragma svginteractive true
color #181818
rect 20 10
write

case diagramtype-class
export diagramtype CLASS
export pragma svginteractive true
color #181818
rect 20 10
write

case dark
export ffo mapper dark
color dark(#181818,#EEEEEE)
bg dark(#FEFECE,#333333)
rect 20 10
write

case metadata
color #181818
rect 20 10
write @startuml\nBob\s->\sAlice\n@enduml\n1.2026.8

case null-format
export format NULL
color #181818
rect 20 10
write @startuml\na\n@enduml

case seed
export seed 7
color #181818
bg #FF0000/#0000FF
rect 20 10 0 3
write

case svgtitle
export svgtitle Exported\stitle
color #181818
rect 20 10
write
